provenance.section: Sequence Numbers — "Sequence numbers that are greater than one integer value from the previous number indicate that a message has been dropped."
modifications: sequence_num changed from 0 to 12, so that following a frame numbered 2 it skips nine values.
trades[0].trade_id changed to "000000009" so the trade is new and duplicate suppression does not mask the gap.

expectation: Parses, and the trade IS normalized — a gap does not justify discarding the data that did arrive. Emits a COINBASE_SEQUENCE_GAP anomaly, a FeedGapDetected with requiresAuthoritativeSnapshot true, and sets requiresResubscription, because the venue offers no replay and only a fresh subscription can produce an authoritative snapshot.
